title: Claude Certified Architect
tagline: A hands-on, self-paced course that takes you from zero to passing the Claude Certified Architect: Foundations (CCA-F) exam — agents, tools, MCP, Claude Code, prompting, and reliability, every term explained.
source_label: Built from Andrew Brown's CCA-F course (ExamPro)
footer_note: A self-paced study course reconstructed from Andrew Brown's Claude Certified Architect: Foundations course (ExamPro). Code snippets are illustrative reconstructions of the patterns shown; adapt them to the current SDK and the official exam guide. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic or ExamPro.

0.name: Pre-flight: set up your workbench
0.blurb: Optional on-ramp: install the SDKs, Claude Code, and your API key, and make your first call — so every later lab just runs.

1.name: Foundations: how Claude agents work
1.blurb: The exam map, the agentic loop, tools, and the stop-reason loop that everything else is built on.

2.name: Prompting & structured output
2.blurb: Steer the model with good prompts and force reliable, schema-shaped output before you orchestrate many agents.

3.name: Orchestration: multi-agent architectures
3.blurb: The heart of Domain 1 — coordinators, decomposition, parallelism, hooks, and handoffs.

4.name: Tools & MCP integration
4.blurb: Discover, distinguish, and build tools with the Model Context Protocol — the concept the exam leans on hardest.

5.name: Claude Code configuration & workflows
5.blurb: Settings, permissions, sandboxing, built-in tools, and turning issues into PRs in CI.

6.name: Context management & reliability
6.blurb: Sessions, the context window, human review, validation retries, large context, and batch processing.

7.name: Capstone: put it all together
7.blurb: Combine the whole course into a support agent that knows when to escalate to a human.
